expectations.says: The child anaesthetised on the day before the first birthday is 0 years and 11 months old, although 365 days have passed since the birth.
expectations.query: SELECT a.age_years, a.age_months, a.age_days FROM omop.anaesthetic a JOIN omop.visit_detail vd ON vd.visit_detail_id = a.visit_detail_id WHERE vd.visit_detail_source_value = '990000231'

expectations.says: The child anaesthetised on the first birthday is one year old, although the anaesthetic starts before the hour of birth.
expectations.query: SELECT a.age_years, a.age_months, a.age_days FROM omop.anaesthetic a JOIN omop.visit_detail vd ON vd.visit_detail_id = a.visit_detail_id WHERE vd.visit_detail_source_value = '990000232'

expectations.says: The child born on 29 February is 0 years and 11 months old on 28 February of the next year.
expectations.query: SELECT a.age_years, a.age_months, a.age_days FROM omop.anaesthetic a JOIN omop.visit_detail vd ON vd.visit_detail_id = a.visit_detail_id WHERE vd.visit_detail_source_value = '990000233'

expectations.says: The child born on 29 February is one year old on 1 March of the next year.
